fml.menu.mods.info.description.whogoesth: Press a key. Ask who is out there. Everything around you answers with its name, distance and direction. Type @mod to narrow it down, with autocomplete.
gui.whogoesthere.title: Who Goes There?
message.whogoesthere.gone: Whatever it was, it is gone now.
item.whogoesthere.stamp.tooltip: Right-click a creature to stamp it: keep its chunk loaded and pin it to the top of the Who Goes There? list
item.whogoesthere.eraser.tooltip: Right-click a creature to remove its stamp
message.whogoesthere.stamp.ok: Stamped %s — chunk kept loaded, pinned to the top.
